name: CLOSE_APPLICATION
description: Close the application.

name: RELOAD_REVIEW
description: Reload repository files and changes.

name: OPEN_KEYMAP_REFERENCE
description: Show the effective keyboard bindings.

name: OPEN_COMMAND_LINE
description: Open the command line to run an application action.

name: CURSOR_UP
description: Move the active cursor up.

name: CURSOR_DOWN
description: Move the active cursor down.

name: CURSOR_PAGE_UP
description: Move the active cursor up by half a viewport.

name: CURSOR_PAGE_DOWN
description: Move the active cursor down by half a viewport.

name: CURSOR_FIRST
description: Move the active cursor to the first item.

name: CURSOR_LAST
description: Move the active cursor to the last item.

name: CURSOR_CENTER
description: Center the active cursor in its viewport.

name: VISUAL_LINE
description: Select lines in Visual mode.

name: DIFF_SWITCH_SIDE
description: Switch diff side.

name: FILE_TREE_ITEM_ACTIVATE
description: Activate the focused file-tree item.

name: TREE_COLLAPSE_OR_PARENT
description: Collapse the focused tree item or focus its parent.

name: TREE_EXPAND
description: Expand the focused tree item.

name: TREE_SIZE_INCREASE
description: Widen the file-tree pane.

name: TREE_SIZE_DECREASE
description: Narrow the file-tree pane.

name: FOCUS_FILE_TREE
description: Focus the file tree.

name: FOCUS_DIFF_PANE
description: Focus the diff pane.

name: SHOW_CHANGES
description: Show changed files in the file tree.

name: SHOW_FILES
description: Show all repository files in the file tree.

name: OPEN_NEXT_FILE
description: Open the next file in the active file-tree mode.

name: OPEN_PREVIOUS_FILE
description: Open the previous file in the active file-tree mode.

name: OPEN_FILE_FINDER
description: Open the file finder.

name: OPEN_FILE_FINDER_ALL
description: Open the file finder including git-ignored files.

name: DIFF_EXPAND_TOGGLE
description: Toggle all unchanged diff regions.

name: DIFF_RELATIVE_LINE_NUMBERS_TOGGLE
description: Toggle relative line numbers in text views.

name: DIFF_WRAP_TOGGLE
description: Toggle text wrapping in the diff view.

name: COPY_FILE_PATH_RELATIVE
description: Copy the active file repository-relative path.

name: COPY_FILE_PATH_ABSOLUTE
description: Copy the active file absolute path.

name: COPY_COMMENTS
description: Copy all review comments as Markdown.

name: ADD_COMMENT
description: Add a comment at the active diff cursor.

name: ADD_FILE_COMMENT
description: Add a comment to the open file.

name: EDIT_COMMENT
description: Edit the comment in the active context.

name: DELETE_COMMENT
description: Delete the comment in the active context.

name: CLEAR_COMMENTS
description: Clear all review comments.
